name: Zabbix Problems
author: ldechnik
description: Unresolved problems from one or more Zabbix servers in the Omarchy bar, summarized by highest active severity.

barWidget.description: Shows the highest unresolved severity and opens a filterable problem list. Servers are added and edited in the panel's expanded view.

schema.label: Problem limit
schema.description: The panel warns when more matching problems exist.

schema.label: Acknowledgement
schema.description: Narrow the panel list and the bar count to problems in this acknowledgement state.

schema.label: Only acknowledged by me
schema.description: Applies only while Acknowledgement is Acknowledged. Needs user.checkAuthentication permitted for the API token's role.

schema.label: Include suppressed problems
schema.description: Suppressed problems are listed with a SUPPRESSED badge. Turn off to hide problems in maintenance.

schema.label: Include symptom problems
schema.description: Off lists only cause problems, so a symptom is not counted again beside its own cause.

schema.label: Include disabled and unmonitored
schema.description: Zabbix keeps reporting problems for disabled triggers and unmonitored hosts; the frontend hides them and so does this. Turn on to audit what has been left switched off.
